observations: Two nearly identical photos show a large black rectangular solar panel standing upright on dirt ground.
The panel has a silver frame and a visible grid of cells.
Watermark text "INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP" appears across the center of both photos; "POSTED ON JI" is partially visible in photo 1.
Another panel leans against a wall in the background left of both photos.
